name: veriscope
description: Cryptographic Bibliographic Index & Fair-Use Citation Verification Engine for AI Agents across 24 disciplines.

VERISCOPE_API_KEY.description: Optional API Key for live primary evidence port. Unauthenticated requests run against built-in 50-canon sandbox.

tools.name: veriscope_discover_concepts
tools.description: Elevate colloquial topics or news into canonical scholarly ontologies across 24 disciplines.

tools.name: veriscope_inspect_topography
tools.description: Retrieve formal axiomatic definitions, Wikidata QIDs, and 3+ historical dialectical disputes.

tools.name: veriscope_locate_evidence
tools.description: Locate fair-use verbatim citations (<=300 chars) with chapter coordinates, 64-bit SHA-256 hashes, and Ed25519 receipts.

tools.name: veriscope_verify_attestation
tools.description: Cryptographically verify whether a cited quote or hash matches genuine verified editions.

tools.name: veriscope_probe_radar
tools.description: Probe cross-disciplinary synaptic radar connections and epistemic blind spots.

tools.name: veriscope_citation_audit
tools.description: Fast-scan draft text or AI responses to extract scholarly citations, cross-check against 50 canonical editions, and detect attribution errors or hallucinations.
